note: All News settings and operator banners in this file are Cherry-made; original LINE PLAY banner content is not redistributed. When banners is empty, What's NEW surfaces organic friend diary posts, personal alerts, active season banners (if include_season_banners is true), and the most active recent public photo diary posts (if include_recommended_posts is true). Today's Best and those hot posts rank public posts made within best_window_hours (0 = no window) by best_like_points per distinct liker plus best_comment_points per distinct commenter; the owner's own likes and comments do not count.
